about.label: About
about.p1: I've been a Junior Developer at Learn Tech since August 2024, working across the Java and Next.js sides of the company's main LMS.
about.p2: Alongside work I'm finishing a B.Eng. in Computer and Electronics Engineering at Ramkhamhaeng University (graduating mid-2027). My final-year project, GoSkillUp LMS, is a learning platform I designed and built from the database to deployment, and I'm still developing it. I also built hatch.dev, a web studio management system now live in production, and WorkCatch, a Thai task-capture app with an AI assistant.
